create_vector_store: create a new vector store with a unique ID, provider, name, description, and metadata via the proxy API
list_vector_stores: list all available vector stores from the database with pagination support via the proxy API
delete_vector_store: delete an existing vector store by its ID from both the database and in-memory registry
get_vector_store_info: retrieve detailed information about a single vector store by its ID from the registry or database
update_vector_store: update an existing vector store's details like name, description, or metadata via the proxy API
